usedFor: GMass holds the campaign emails, and Asana receives a task through “Create Task or Subtask” when “Email Replied” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Replied” in GMass, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A reply needs a person to answer it, so the task gives it an owner and a date.

watchOut: GMass triggers are polling, so a reply becomes a task after a scheduled check, not at once.
